q: log(a + b) = log a + log b
why: Only when a + b = ab, for example a = b = 2. The real rule is log(ab) = log a + log b.

o: Because 1000 has 3 zeros, and that's all a log counts
why: log₁₀ x is the power you raise 10 to in order to get x. Counting zeros only works for exact powers of 10.
x is a power, not a factor. 2⁵ = 32, so x = 5 (or x = log 32 / log 2).
Myth. Adding powers means multiplying: e^(a + b) = eᵃ · eᵇ.

q: GDP grows 3% a year. About how long until it doubles?
why: Growth compounds: ln 2 / ln 1.03 ≈ 23.4 years (rule of 70: 70/3). 33 years ignores compounding.
